GENERATOR: OMLDCT02/code/omldct02_seed_manifest.py — committed, and this list is fully recomputable from it plus the recorded nonces
DERIVATION: seed(role, index, nonce) = the first 4 bytes, big-endian, of sha256('<OMLDCT01 invalid-closure tip>|OMLDCT02|<law string>|<role>|<index>' and, only when a nonce is needed, '|<nonce>'), interpreted as an unsigned 32-bit integer. nonce starts at 0 and increments only when the candidate collides with an already-accepted OMLDCT02 seed or with the forbidden set. Every nonce actually used is recorded, so the whole list is recomputable from this file alone.
WHY_N_BASE_IS_NOT_474: OMLDCT01 froze 474 base seeds and disclosed P(reaching 41 pairs) = 0.5063. The recomputation in OMLDCT02_DESIGN_RECOMPUTED.json shows that probability was governed by the LENGTH OF THE SEED LIST, not by the 512-instance ceiling: with the ceiling alone the probability is 1.0000 and the largest number of seeds ever consumed in 20000 simulated campaigns was 788. A 474-long list stops the campaign before the frozen ceiling does. OMLDCT02 freezes 1024 so that the frozen ceiling is what binds. No frozen design quantity moves: the target is still 41 pairs and the ceiling is still 512 arm instances.

FORBIDDEN_SET.rule: a deliberate superset. Every integer in [0, 2**32) under any key containing 'seed' in any JSON in the repository, every _s<digits> or seed<digits> token in any filename in the repository, and every such token in every .npz filename on the Windows device. Over-excluding costs nothing; under-excluding would let OMLDCT02 reuse a seed whose outcome is already known somewhere in the programme.

ACCRUAL_ORDER: BASE index 0 upward. A base seed without an admissible trigger consumes its cost and is never selectively replaced. A technical retry reuses the identical seed and arm. Reserves are technical only.
SEED_SET_HASH_RULE: H.seed_set_hash: canonical digest of [[role, index, seed], ...] in frozen order. Rules in omldct02_hashes.CANONICAL_RULES.
